name: CMA - Platform Lever
author: Lever Heritage Collection
notes: 16g dose, 32g yield (1:2.0), 90C. Original peak 9.5 bar clipped flat to 9.0 bar and held 4.0s, the time the original curve spent above the cap. Preinfusion rises to boiler pressure (1.2 bar) and ends on first drops at 0.5g, 40s backstop, flow limited to 4 mL/s. Spring release 1.5s. Decline indexed on grams delivered (25.3g span), linear. All time triggers relative to stage entry. The 30s backstop on the decline is load-bearing: a stalled puck will otherwise hold peak pressure.

display.shortDescription: CMA platform lever. The Italian bar reference at 9 bar.
display.description: Replicates the CMA platform lever, the most widely used commercial lever group in Italian espresso history. CMA manufactured this group for Astoria, Wega, Victoria Arduino, La Pavoni Bar and Brasilia. 52mm piston, 140mm spring, 9.0 bar peak with a balanced, even decline. This is what espresso tasted like in Italian bars from the 1950s through the 1990s. Forgiving across a range of grind settings. 16g dose, 32g yield, 90C. Rebuilt at 16g in, 32g out, peak clipped to 9.0 bar, decline indexed on weight.
